title: Building on fire
description: Big fire in an old brick building, flames coming out of the roof and top windows, tons of black smoke. Fire brigade just got here but it's spreading fast!!
credit: Photo: Sylvain Pedneault, CC BY-SA 3.0, Wikimedia Commons https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Fire_inside_an_abandoned_convent_in_Massueville,_Quebec,_Canada.jpg

title: Car crash on the street
description: Two cars crashed into each other on the street, front of one car is smashed and leaking fluid on the road. Blocking a lane, traffic going around it.
credit: Photo: Lowdown, CC BY-SA 4.0, Wikimedia Commons https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Road_accident_at_Rymanowska_Street_in_Sanok_(2024).jpg

title: Deep pothole on a crossing
description: Huge deep pothole right at the pedestrian crossing, full of muddy water so you can't see how deep it is. Cars swerving to avoid it.
credit: Photo: Miguel Tremblay, Public domain, Wikimedia Commons https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Pothole_in_Villeray,_Montr%C3%A9al.jpg

title: Overflowing bins on pavement
description: Bins overflowing again, lid won't close and cardboard boxes and rubbish piled all over the pavement next to them. Nobody has collected it for days.
credit: Photo: Acabashi, CC BY-SA 4.0, Wikimedia Commons https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Commercial_waste_bins_rubbish_Lordship_Lane_Tottenham,_London,_England_1.jpg

title: Fallen tree across the road
description: Tree fell over in the wind, roots ripped out of the pavement and it's lying across the road and the sidewalk. Cars can't get through on this side.
credit: Photo: Vauxford, CC BY-SA 4.0, Wikimedia Commons https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Fallen_Tree_in_Dormer_Place,_Leamington_Spa.jpg

title: Flooded underpass
description: Underpass completely flooded, water up to the car doors. A car is stuck in the middle, please send help!
credit: Photo: Igor123121, CC BY-SA 4.0, Wikimedia Commons https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Modern_residential_development_in_G%C3%B3rka_Narodowa._Pr%C4%85dnik_Bia%C5%82y,_Krak%C3%B3w,_Poland.jpg

title: Graffiti on a park bench
description: Someone sprayed graffiti all over the bench by the path in the park. Not urgent, just looks bad.
credit: Photo: JIP, CC BY-SA 4.0, Wikimedia Commons https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Bench_in_Matinkyl%C3%A4_with_graffiti_on_a_sunny_afternoon_in_July_2025.jpg

title: Gas smell in stairwell
description: Strong smell of gas in the stairwell of our building at Długa street, getting worse.
